hints.title: Length Invariance
hints.text: Every query and dictionary word shares identical string length. Compare positional characters.

hints.title: Hamming Distance Calculation
hints.text: For each query, test against words in the dictionary to see if any word differs at two or fewer positions.

hints.title: Early Termination Match
hints.text: As soon as a dictionary word with edit distance at most two is identified, keep the query and proceed.

hints.title: Positional Mismatch Verification Implementation

complexity.notes: Given constraints Q, D <= 100 and L <= 100, direct comparison executes well under typical limits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching all possible 2-edit mutations of each query generates L^2 * 26^2 permutations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond the resulting answer list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Evaluates problem constraints and recognizes that direct word-to-word comparison is optimal.
